kurz: How much and how vigorously you work something decides the network, the air and the [[emulsion|emulsion]].
bild_im_kopf: A dial between stroking and kneading through.
was_passiert: Kneading strengthens the [[glutenbildung|gluten network]]; whisking brings in air and breaks fat into fine droplets. Too much of it makes cake tough, egg whites grainy and cream turn to butter.
faustregeln: Bread: a lot. Cake: little. Egg whites: until glossy and stiff, then stop.

params.rechts: a lot: strong network, lots of air, risk of overworking
